verdict.rationale: The project claims 'no frustrating setup required' (gh-1). Hands-on reports describe GUI-driven setup that non-technical users finished in minutes, with Ollama models auto-detected and manual model configuration also available (comm-6, comm-9, comm-1). None of the evidence explicitly documents a step-by-step first-run wizard, a credential-entry flow, or any channel configuration. missing for 10: documented first-run onboarding wizard, guided model-credential entry, channel setup, default-settings walkthrough, explicit confirmation that no config-file editing is needed for self-hosted installs
